metadata.description: Custom Claude Code skills for the CATA team (branch merges, PR review requests, and more).

plugins.name: branch-merge-gro
plugins.description: Merge one or more feature/fix branches into the shared demo/gro staging branch for a repo, in place, with a fixed safe routine (no new branches, no force-push, stop-and-ask on conflicts).

plugins.name: pr-review-slack
plugins.description: Turn one or more GitHub PR links into a ready-to-send Slack review-request message: resolve titles, tag repos, pick reviewers, confirm, then post.

plugins.name: jira-deploy-status
plugins.description: Post a proactive deploy-status update on a JIRA ticket: look up the ticket, find related PRs across the sambatechno repos, work out the pipeline stage, draft an English status comment, and post it after approval.
